title: The I3322 quantum value: certified window, finite-dimensional nonattainment, and nonclosure of Cq(3,3;2,2)
description: Certified two-sided window for the I3322 quantum supremum S, tensor/commuting value equality, and (v3.0.0) restoration of finite-dimensional nonattainment of S and nonclosure of C_q(3,3;2,2) by an independent proof route that survived three rounds of refutation-first adversarial review. The exact optimum beyond the certified 3.61e-9 window and spatial attainment at S remain open. Complete correction record preserved.
